## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C reorganization and TRA execution

- 2016-12-19: 144A private placement and Up-C restructuring; Non-Blocker TRA executed at 85% sharing rate with Crestview Partners II SES Investment B, LLC as Non-Blocker Holders and Crestview Partners II GP as agent
- 2017-04-28: Registered IPO under "WTTR" on NYSE
- 2017-07-18: Amendment No. 1 executed concurrent with the Rockwater merger agreement, carving the Rockwater transaction out of the Change of Control trigger

#### Routine maintenance

- 2023-06-23: Amendment No. 2 transitions LIBOR references to CME Term SOFR plus 71.513 basis points pursuant to the LIBOR Act; no change to economic terms

## Explanation

Select Energy Services, Inc. (renamed Select Water Solutions, Inc. in 2023) executed two parallel Tax Receivable Agreements on December 19, 2016 at its 144A Up-C reorganization. This Non-Blocker TRA covers the Crestview-affiliated Non-Blocker Holders side, with reorganization-attributable basis step-ups from their contribution at the 144A reorganization; the parallel Legacy TRA covers SES Legacy Holdings. Both TRAs share an 85% sharing rate, identical tax-attribute coverage, and underwent the same two amendments: a July 2017 Change of Control carve-out for the Rockwater merger and a June 2023 LIBOR-to-SOFR benchmark transition. Both remain in force as of the FY2025 10-K; the parallel structure is an administrative artifact of the different pre-reorganization blocker structures rather than a substantive divergence in economic terms. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the parallel Legacy TRA.
